name: media-agent
description: Media production by an agent on a machine with an 8 GB GPU and commercial licensing, one skill per modality with rules that hold for any model: image and video generation, image retouching, voice-over at -16 LUFS, music and sound with per-item licenses, video composed as code, editing finished video, a 3D product turntable, scripted 3D scenes with characters in Blender, and sourcing rules for factual videos. Two hooks warn: where vipsthumbnail -o really writes, and when Kinocut runs before any skill is loaded.
